disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 15:11: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

first_reader_said: 1CH 15:11: David summons the six chiefs just listed in 15:5-10, so this Joel is the Gershomite chief of 15:7 that A holds, and B is the same man held again.

why: Joel the Gershomite chief in 1CH 15:7 is the Joel David summons among the Levite chiefs in 1CH 15:11, the sole verse assigned to A. The associations with Zetham and the Laadan/Jehieli family in 1CH 23:8 and 26:22 supply further information without distinguishing another person represented by A. A is a thinner duplicate of B.
